  ```ts
  import type { TasksViewProps } from "@/components/tasks/TasksView";
  export const FIXTURES: Record<"default" | "empty" | "filtered-empty" | "loading" | "error" | "offline", Pick<TasksViewProps, "state" | "data" | "online">> = { … };
  ```
  `default`: state `"default"`, online `true`, data = the four groups of the TaskGroups harness, copied verbatim from `apps/web/app/e2e/components/task-groups/page.tsx` (TFV2-0128c; same ids, titles and fields), `shownCount: 12`, `laterShown: 2`, `laterTotal: 5`, `filters: { search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }`, `quickAddBusy: false`, `toast: null`. `empty`: state `"empty"`, groups `[]`, all counts `0`, same filters. `filtered-empty`: state `"filtered-empty"`, groups `[]`, counts `0`, `filters: { search: "bank", energy: "high", priority: "any", sort: "due" }`. `loading`: state `"loading"`, data of `empty`. `error`: state `"error"`, data of `empty`. `offline`: the `default` entry with `online: false`.

  Page (`apps/web/app/(tempo)/tasks/page.tsx`, starts with `"use client";`):
  - `const E2E_SIGNED_OUT = process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" && process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TEMPO_E2E_AUTH_BYPASS === "1";` (same test as `allowLocalTaskViews` in `TaskViewsScreen.tsx`).
  - `const NOOP = { onQuickAdd: () => {}, onFiltersChange: () => {}, onClearFilters: () => {}, onToggle: () => {}, onToggleStep: () => {}, onOpen: () => {}, onLoadMore: () => {}, onRetry: () => {}, onUndo: () => {}, onDismissToast: () => {} } satisfies Omit<TasksViewProps, "state" | "data" | "online">;`
  - `export default function Page() { return <Suspense fallback={null}><TasksPage /></Suspense>; }` (`useE2EState` uses `useSearchParams`).
  - `TasksPage`: `const forced = useE2EState(); const online = useOnline();` When `forced !== null`: `const fx = forced in FIXTURES ? FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error; return <TasksView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />;` (forced mode is display-only: every handler is a no-op and no Convex hook runs, because the data hooks live only in `TasksLive`). Otherwise: `const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useConvexAuth(); if (E2E_SIGNED_OUT && !isLoading && !isAuthenticated) return <TaskViewsScreen view="inbox" />;` (today's signed-out local-store screen, unchanged, so `task-views-core.spec.ts` keeps passing — subject to R3-Q1); else `return <ProfileReady fallback={<TasksView {...FIXTURES.loading} online={online} {...NOOP} />}><TasksBoundary online={online}><TasksLive online={online} /></TasksBoundary></ProfileReady>;`.
  - `class TasksBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }>`: `state = { failed: false, attempt: 0 }`; `static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }`; `render()` → when `failed`: `<TasksView {...FIXTURES.error} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP} onRetry={() => this.setState((s) => ({ failed: false, attempt: s.attempt + 1 }))} />`; else `<Fragment key={this.state.attempt}>{this.props.children}</Fragment>` (a new key remounts `TasksLive`, which re-subscribes its queries). Convex `useQuery` throws on a server error, which this boundary catches.
  - `TasksLive({ online })`: `const prefs = useQuery(api.preferences.get, {}); const [filters, setFilters] = useState<TasksFilters>({ search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }); const rows = useQuery(api.tasks.list, { search: filters.search.trim() || undefined, energy: filters.energy === "all" ? undefined : filters.energy, priority: filters.priority === "any" ? undefined : filters.priority }); const [laterLimit, setLaterLimit] = useState(20); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState<TasksToast | null>(null); const undoRef = useRef<(() => Promise<unknown>) | null>(null); const router = useRouter();` and the four mutations `createQuick`, `toggleCompletion`, `update`, `remove` via `useMutation(api.tasks.<name>)`.
  - Derivation (non-exported helpers in page.tsx): `isoInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: tz, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(ms)`; `timeInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: tz, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(ms)`; `zoneOffsetMs(ms, tz)` = UTC ms of the zone's wall clock at `ms` (from `formatToParts` with `hourCycle: "h23"`, year…second) minus `Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000`; `zonedMs(iso, hhmm, tz)` (the UTC ms of wall-clock `iso` `hhmm` in `tz`) = `const u = Date.parse(iso + "T" + hhmm + ":00Z"); return u - zoneOffsetMs(u - zoneOffsetMs(u, tz), tz);`. With `tz = prefs.timeZone`, `today = isoInZone(Date.now(), tz)`, `weekEnd = addDays(today, (prefs.weekStartsOn + 6 - new Date(today + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay() + 7) % 7)` (`addDays` from `@/lib/period-pages`). Each row → `TaskItem`: `id: row._id`, `title`, `done: row.status === "done"`, `energy: row.energy ?? "medium"`, `priority`, `minutes: row.timeEstimate && row.timeEstimate > 0 ? Math.round(row.timeEstimate / 60_000) : null`, `dueDate: row.dueAt === undefined ? null : isoInZone(row.dueAt, tz)`, `dueTime: row.dueAt === undefined || timeInZone(row.dueAt, tz) === "23:59" ? null : timeInZone(row.dueAt, tz)` (23:59 is the end-of-day "no time" value the app stores), `doneTime: row.status === "done" && row.completedAt !== undefined ? timeInZone(row.completedAt, tz) : null`, `steps: (row.checklist ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, text: c.text, done: c.completed }))`. Rows dropped: `status === "cancelled"`; `status === "done"` with no `completedAt` or `isoInZone(completedAt, tz) < today` (done tasks stay until tomorrow). Group: `dueDate !== null && dueDate <= today` → `today` (an earlier open task is shown in Today, never called late); else `steps.length > 0` → `checklists`; else `dueDate !== null && dueDate <= weekEnd` → `week`; else `later`. Inside a group: open before done, then by `filters.sort`: `due` → `dueAt` ascending (none last), `energy` → low, medium, high, then `dueAt`; `minutes` → `minutes` ascending (null last); ties by `title.localeCompare`. `later` is cut to its first `laterLimit`; `laterShown = Math.min(laterLimit, later.length)`, `laterTotal = later.length`; groups with 0 tasks are left out. `shownCount` = all kept rows. `state`: `rows === undefined || prefs === undefined` → `"loading"`; kept rows 0 and filters equal the defaults → `"empty"`; kept rows 0 otherwise → `"filtered-empty"`; else `"default"`.
  - Handlers: `onQuickAdd({ text })` → `setBusy(true); try { const taskId = await createQuick({ title: text, dueAt: zonedMs(addDays(today, 1), "00:00", tz) - 1 }); undoRef.current = () => remove({ taskId }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), kind: "added", undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); } finally { setBusy(false); }` (the new task lands in Today, matching the "Added to Today" toast). `onToggle({ taskId })` → `const r = await toggleCompletion({ taskId: taskId as Id<"tasks"> }); if (r.status === "done") { undoRef.current = () => toggleCompletion({ taskId: taskId as Id<"tasks"> }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), kind: "done", undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); }`. `onToggleStep({ taskId, stepId })` → find the row in `rows`; `await update({ taskId: row._id, checklist: toggleChecklistItem(row.checklist ?? [], stepId) })` (`toggleChecklistItem` from `@/convex/lib/taskChecklists`). `onFiltersChange(next)` → `setFilters(next); setLaterLimit(20)`. `onClearFilters()` → `setFilters({ search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }); setLaterLimit(20)`. `onOpen({ taskId })` → `router.replace("/tasks?task=" + encodeURIComponent(taskId), { scroll: false })` (TFV2-0129b reads `?task=`). `onLoadMore()` → `setLaterLimit((n) => n + 20)`. `onUndo()` → `const u = undoRef.current; undoRef.current = null; setToast(null); if (u) await u();`. `onDismissToast()` → `undoRef.current = null; setToast(null)`. `onRetry` is supplied by `TasksBoundary`; inside `TasksLive` it is a no-op. The View calls each handler and ignores its promise; a failed Undo shows the UndoToast's own error line (`gx.toast.undoError`), and a failed Quick add / tick / step tick leaves the list unchanged (the reactive query still shows the true rows) with no new copy, because the v3 design has none for it (the builder lists this under REPORT `notes for ticket sync`).
  - Render: `<TasksView state={state} data={{ groups, shownCount, laterShown, laterTotal, filters, quickAddBusy: busy, toast }} online={online} …handlers />`.
  States: as TFV2-0128a (`default`, `empty`, `filtered-empty`, `loading`, `error`) plus forced `offline`. Copy: none of its own (all in TasksView). RTL / keyboard / breakpoints / motion: from TasksView. Route wrapper: the page adds no wrapper element; no existing spec asserts a `/tasks` wrapper test id.
  Compat selectors: signed-out CI spec `tests/e2e/task-views-core.spec.ts:29-36` (`main` heading `Inbox`, `Edit {title}`, `Edit task title`, `Save task`) is kept by the `TaskViewsScreen` branch; storage-state specs (`tests/e2e/screens/tasks-edit.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/acceptance/alpha.spec.ts:119-142`, `tests/e2e/screens/activity.spec.ts:24-27`, `tests/e2e/mcp.spec.ts:63-64`) open `/tasks` signed in and reach `TasksView`: `mcp.spec.ts` (title text visible) and `activity.spec.ts` `Add task` keep working; the `Inbox` / `Task title` / inline-editor assertions do not (R3-Q1).

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/tasks/TaskSheetView.tsx ("use client")
  export type TaskSheetLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";   // convex/tasks.ts energy values
  export type TaskSheetState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";  // "empty" = new task, blank fields
  export type TaskSheetTask = {
    title: string;
    date: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD" or "" (no day)
    time: string;               // "HH:MM" 24-hour or "" (no time)
    minutes: number | null;     // planned length; null = not set
    kind: "fixed" | "flex";
    energy: TaskSheetLevel;
    notes: string;
  };
  export type TaskSheetNag = { on: boolean; phrase: string };
  export type TaskSheetData = {
    taskId: string | null;      // null in state "empty"
    task: TaskSheetTask;        // initial field values; the form resets when taskId changes
    nag: TaskSheetNag | null;   // null → the nag section is not rendered
    saving: boolean;            // true → Save disabled + aria-busy, Delete disabled
  };
  export type TaskSheetValues = TaskSheetTask & { nag: TaskSheetNag | null };
  export type TaskSheetViewProps = {
    state: TaskSheetState;
    data: TaskSheetData;
    online: boolean;            // false → StateOffline at the top of the body; the form stays usable
    onSave: (args: { taskId: string | null; values: TaskSheetValues }) => void; // values trimmed (title, notes, phrase)
    onDelete: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onClose: () => void;        // Close button, Cancel, Esc, scrim click
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function TaskSheetView(props: TaskSheetViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  Markup (fragment root): `<div className="tp-sheet-scrim" aria-hidden="true" onClick={onClose} />` then `<section className="tp-sheet tp-glass" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} data-component="MobileSheet" data-view="TaskSheetView" onKeyDown={trap}>`:
  - `<span className="tp-sheet__grabber" aria-hidden="true" />`;
  - `<div className="tp-sheet__head"><h2 className="tp-sheet__title" id={titleId}>{state === "empty" ? copy.newTitle : copy.title}</h2><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.close} onClick={onClose}><TpIcon name="x" /></button></div>`;
  - `<div className="tp-sheet__body">`: `{!online && <StateOffline text={copy.offline} />}`; `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={4} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `default`/`empty` → `<form className="tp-form" data-component="Form" id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={submit}>` holding, in order: `<TextInput id={nameId} label={copy.name} value={v.title} onChange=… error={nameError ? copy.nameErr : undefined} />`; a row `<div className="tp-toolbar">` with three `.tp-field`s — `<label className="tp-label" htmlFor={dateId}>{copy.date}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={dateId} type="date" dir="ltr" value={v.date} …/>`, the same for time (`type="time"`, `step={300}`, label `copy.time`), and `<Select id={lenId} label={copy.len} value={v.minutes === null ? "" : String(v.minutes)} options={lengthOptions} onChange=… />`; `<RadioGroup legend={copy.kind}><Radio id={fixedId} name={kindName} value="fixed" label={copy.fixed} hint={copy.fixedHint} checked={v.kind === "fixed"} onChange=… /><Radio id={flexId} name={kindName} value="flex" label={copy.flex} hint={copy.flexHint} checked={v.kind === "flex"} onChange=… /></RadioGroup>`; `<Segmented label={copy.energy} block options={[{ value: "low", label: copy.energyLow }, { value: "medium", label: copy.energyMedium }, { value: "high", label: copy.energyHigh }]} value={v.energy} onChange=… />`; when `data.nag !== null`: `<Switch id={nagId} label={copy.nag} help={copy.nagHelp} checked={v.nag.on} onChange=… />` and, only while `v.nag.on`, `<TextInput id={phraseId} label={copy.phrase} help={copy.phraseHelp} value={v.nag.phrase} onChange=… error={phraseError ? copy.phraseErr : undefined} />`; `<Textarea id={notesId} label={copy.notes} rows={3} value={v.notes} onChange=… />`. `lengthOptions` = `[{ value: "", label: copy.lenNone }, …[10, 15, 25, 45].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: copy.lenMin.replace("{n}", String(n)) })), { value: "60", label: copy.lenHour }]`, plus `{ value: String(m), label: copy.lenMin.replace("{n}", String(m)) }` inserted in numeric order when the task's own `minutes` (m) is not one of 10/15/25/45/60.
  - `<div className="tp-sheet__foot">` (states `default`/`empty` only): `<button type="submit" form={formId} className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={data.saving} aria-busy={data.saving || undefined}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{copy.save}</span></button>`, `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>{copy.cancel}</button>`, and in `default` only `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--danger-ghost" disabled={data.saving} onClick={() => onDelete({ taskId: data.taskId! })}><TpIcon name="x" size="sm" /><span>{copy.delete}</span></button>`.
  Behaviour: the form values `v` are local state seeded from `data.task` and `data.nag` (re-seeded when `data.taskId` changes). Submit: `title = v.title.trim()`; empty → `nameError = true`, focus the name input, no callback; `v.nag?.on && !v.nag.phrase.trim()` → `phraseError = true`, focus the phrase input, no callback; else `onSave({ taskId: data.taskId, values: { ...v, title, notes: v.notes.trim(), nag: v.nag && { on: v.nag.on, phrase: v.nag.phrase.trim() } } })`. Editing a field clears its error. Switching the nag off hides the phrase field and clears `phraseError`. Focus: on mount the name input is focused (`loading`/`error`: the Close button); `trap` keeps Tab inside the section (Tab on the last focusable → first; Shift+Tab on the first → last; focusables = enabled `button, input, select, textarea, [href]` inside the section); Esc anywhere in the section calls `onClose`; on unmount focus returns to the element that was focused when the sheet mounted (`useEffect` stores `document.activeElement`).
  Copy (`COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`):

  | key | EN | HE |

  | loading | Loading this task | טוענים את המשימה |
  | error | Couldn't load this task. | לא הצלחנו לטעון את המשימה. |

  | nameErr | Type a short task name first. (repo `tasks.titleNeeded`) | כדאי לכתוב קודם שם קצר למשימה. (repo `tasks.titleNeeded`) |

  | time | Time | שעה |
  | len | How long | כמה זמן |
  | lenNone | No length yet | בלי אורך עדיין |
  | lenMin | {n} min | {n} דק׳ |

  | phraseErr | Add a phrase first. A nag needs your own words before it can switch on. | קודם להוסיף משפט. תזכורת צריכה את המילים שלך לפני שאפשר להפעיל אותה. |
  | notes | Notes | הערות |
  | save | Save | שמירה |
  | cancel | Cancel | ביטול |
  | delete | Delete | מחיקה |

  The design's Hebrew offline line addresses the person with a gendered verb; the neutral form above replaces it (CONVENTIONS §12). The Switch's On / Off words ("On"/"פועל", "Off"/"כבוי") come from TFV2-0116; StateError adds "Your data is safe." / "המידע שלך שמור." and "Try again" / "לנסות שוב".
  States: `default` (existing task, Delete shown), `empty` (new task: `copy.newTitle`, blank values, no Delete), `loading` (skeleton, no form, no foot), `error` (StateError, no form, no foot); offline = `online: false` with the form usable; `saving` is `data.saving: true`.
  Harness sections (order → props): `default` (state default, taskId `"t1"`, task `{ title: "Draft 3 slides for Thursday", date: "2026-10-12", time: "09:00", minutes: 25, kind: "flex", energy: "medium", notes: "Outline, one slide, check the numbers with Dana." }`, nag `null`, saving false, online true); `empty` (state empty, taskId `null`, task `{ title: "", date: "", time: "", minutes: null, kind: "flex", energy: "medium", notes: "" }`, nag null); `nag` (the `default` props with `nag: { on: false, phrase: "" }`); `loading`; `error` (both with the `empty` data); `offline` (the `default` props with `online: false`); `saving` (the `default` props with `saving: true`).
  Tokens (tempo.css, unchanged): sheet `--tp-glass` panel, radius `--tp-radius-xl`, body padding `--tp-space-5`, gap `--tp-space-3`, foot border `--tp-glass-line`, title `--tp-font-serif` `--tp-text-lg`, scrim `--tp-scrim`. RTL: logical properties; the Close button sits at the inline end (left in Hebrew); date/time inputs stay `dir="ltr"`; the primary Save is first in reading order in both languages. Screen reader: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`, named by the heading; errors are linked through the field components; StateLoading is `role="status"`.  
  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/journal/JournalView.tsx ("use client")
  export type JournalState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type JournalEntry = {
    id: string;          // notes row id; link target /notes/<id>
    date: string;        // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    title: string;       // page title; "" → the formatted date is the title
    tags: string[];      // page-meta tags (≤ 12), user text
  };
  export type JournalData = {
    today: string;       // "YYYY-MM-DD" in the person's time zone
    prompt: string;      // today's prompt, already localised (one of the repo's journal.p.1 … journal.p.7)
    entries: JournalEntry[];  // past days only, newest first
    hasMore: boolean;    // true → "Show more" button
    loadingMore: boolean;
  };
  export type JournalViewProps = {
    state: JournalState;
    data: JournalData;
    online: boolean;     // false → StateOffline under the head; links and buttons stay usable
    onAnotherPrompt: () => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function JournalView(props: JournalViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

  | prompt | Today's prompt (repo `journal.prompt`) | השאלה של היום |

  | more | Show more (repo `journal.more`) | להציג עוד |
  | emptyTitle | Your journal is ready when you are. | היומן כאן כשמתאים לך. |
  | emptyBody | Write one line about today, or answer the prompt. There's no right length. | אפשר לכתוב שורה אחת על היום, או לענות על השאלה. אין אורך נכון. |

  | error | Couldn't load your journal. | לא הצלחנו לטעון את היומן. |

FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error; return <JournalView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />;` (display-only; no Convex hook runs in this branch).     title: string;              // trimmed, non-empty
  ```ts
    date: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    start: string;              // "HH:MM" 24-hour
    end: string;                // "HH:MM", later than start on the same day
    kind: "fixed" | "flex";
    place: string;              // trimmed; "" = none
  };
  export type AddEventSheetProps = {
    initialDate: string;        // "YYYY-MM-DD" preset for the Day field
    saving: boolean;            // true → Save disabled + aria-busy
    online: boolean;            // false → StateOffline at the top of the body; the form stays usable
    onSave: (values: AddEventValues) => void;
    onClose: () => void;        // Close, Cancel, Esc, scrim
  };
  export function AddEventSheet(props: AddEventSheetProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  Markup (fragment root): `<div className="tp-sheet-scrim" aria-hidden="true" onClick={onClose} />` and `<section className="tp-sheet tp-glass" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} data-component="MobileSheet" data-view="AddEventSheet" onKeyDown={trap}>` → `<span className="tp-sheet__grabber" aria-hidden="true" />`; `<div className="tp-sheet__head"><h2 className="tp-sheet__title" id={titleId}>{copy.title}</h2><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.close} onClick={onClose}><TpIcon name="x" /></button></div>`; `<div className="tp-sheet__body">{!online && <StateOffline />}<form className="tp-form" data-component="Form" id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={submit}>` with, in order: `<TextInput id={nameId} label={copy.name} placeholder={copy.namePh} value={v.title} onChange=… error={nameError ? copy.nameErr : undefined} autoComplete="off" />`; a `.tp-field` with `<label className="tp-label" htmlFor={dateId}>{copy.date}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={dateId} type="date" dir="ltr" value={v.date} …/>`; `<div className="tp-toolbar">` with two `.tp-field`s: start (`<label htmlFor={startId}>{copy.start}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={startId} type="time" step={300} dir="ltr" …/>`) and end (`copy.end`, same input with `aria-invalid={endError || undefined}` and `aria-describedby={endError ? endErrId : undefined}`, then `{endError && <p className="tp-error-text" id={endErrId} role="alert">{copy.endErr}</p>}`); `<RadioGroup legend={copy.kind}><Radio id={fixedId} name={kindName} value="fixed" label={copy.fixed} hint={copy.fixedHint} checked={v.kind === "fixed"} onChange=… /><Radio id={flexId} name={kindName} value="flex" label={copy.flex} hint={copy.flexHint} checked={v.kind === "flex"} onChange=… /></RadioGroup>`; `<TextInput id={placeId} label={copy.place} optional value={v.place} onChange=… autoComplete="off" />`. Foot `<div className="tp-sheet__foot"><button type="submit" form={formId} className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={saving} aria-busy={saving || undefined}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{copy.save}</span></button><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>{copy.cancel}</button></div>`.
  Behaviour: local form state `v` starts `{ title: "", date: initialDate, start: "10:00", end: "11:00", kind: "fixed", place: "" }` (the design's defaults). Submit: `title = v.title.trim()`; empty → `nameError`, focus name, no callback; `v.end <= v.start` (string compare of "HH:MM") → `endError`, focus end, no callback; else `onSave({ ...v, title, place: v.place.trim() })`. Editing a field clears its error. Focus: name input on mount; Tab / Shift+Tab wrap inside the section; Esc calls `onClose`; on unmount focus returns to the element focused at mount.

  ```ts
  export type CalendarData = {
    month: string;               // "YYYY-MM" shown in the grid

    selected: string;            // "YYYY-MM-DD"

    sheet: { open: boolean; saving: boolean };
    toast: { id: number; undoUntilMs: number } | null;
  };
  export type CalendarViewProps = {
    state: CalendarState;
    data: CalendarData;
    online: boolean;             // false → StateOffline under the head; everything stays usable
    onSelectDay: (date: string) => void;
    onPrevMonth: () => void;
    onNextMonth: () => void;
    onOpenAdd: () => void;
    onCloseAdd: () => void;
    onAddEvent: (values: AddEventValues) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
    onUndo: () => void;
    onDismissToast: () => void;
  };
  export function CalendarView(props: CalendarViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

  3. States `default` / `empty`: `<div className="tp-split" data-component="Split">` with (a) `<section className="tp-surface" data-component="Surface" aria-label={copy.title}>` holding `<MonthGrid title={monthTitle} weekStartsOn={data.weekStartsOn} days={data.days} selected={data.selected} onSelectDay={onSelectDay} onPrev={onPrevMonth} onNext={onNextMonth} />` and the legend `<ul className="tp-toolbar tp-small tp-muted" aria-label={copy.legend}><li><Dot kind="fixed" /><span>{copy.lgFixed}</span></li><li><Dot kind="flex" /><span>{copy.lgFlex}</span></li><li><Dot kind="done" /><span>{copy.lgDone}</span></li></ul>`; (b) in `default`: `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby={dayId}><div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id={dayId} tabIndex={-1}>{dayTitle}</h2>{data.dayEvents.length > 0 && <span className="tp-section__count">{count}</span>}</div>{data.dayEvents.length > 0 ? <EventBlock events={data.dayEvents} timeZone={data.timeZone} /> : <div className="tp-empty" data-component="Empty"><TpIcon name="leaf" size="lg" /><p>{copy.dayEmpty}</p><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onOpenAdd}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.add}</span></button></div>}{data.selected === data.today && <div><a className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/today"><TpIcon name="today" size="sm" /><span>{copy.openDay}</span></a></div>}</section>`; in `empty`: `<StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} icon={<TpIcon name="calendar-grid" size="lg" />} action={<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onOpenAdd}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.add}</span></button>} />` (the grid stays so other months can be reached). `count` = `copy.items1` when 1, else `copy.itemsN` with `{n}` in `.tp-num`. `monthTitle` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB", { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(Date.parse(data.month + "-01T00:00:00Z"))`; `dayTitle` = the same formatter with `{ weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" }` on `data.selected`.

  - `CalendarPage`: `const forced = useE2EState(); const online = useOnline();` forced → `const fx = forced in FIXTURES ? FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error;` render `<CalendarView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />` (display-only; no Convex hook in this branch). Else `const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useConvexAuth(); if (E2E_SIGNED_OUT && !isLoading && !isAuthenticated) return <CalendarViews eventSourceMode="local" />;` (today's local-store screen, unchanged — keeps `calendar-views.spec.ts` and the local case of `fix/calendar-add.spec.ts` green, subject to R3-Q1); else `<ProfileReady fallback={<CalendarView {...FIXTURES.loading} online={online} {...NOOP} />}><CalendarBoundary online={online}><CalendarLive online={online} /></CalendarBoundary></ProfileReady>`.
  - `CalendarBoundary`: `class CalendarBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }>`: `state = { failed: false, attempt: 0 }`; `static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }`; `render()` → when `failed`: `<CalendarView {...FIXTURES.error} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP} onRetry={() => this.setState((s) => ({ failed: false, attempt: s.attempt + 1 }))} />`; else `<Fragment key={this.state.attempt}>{this.props.children}</Fragment>` (a new key remounts the data component, which re-subscribes its queries).
  - Helpers (non-exported, in page.tsx): `isoInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: tz, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(ms)`; `timeInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: tz, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(ms)`; `zoneOffsetMs(ms, tz)` = UTC ms of the zone's wall clock at `ms` (from `formatToParts` with `hourCycle: "h23"`, year…second) minus `Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000`; `zonedMs(iso, hhmm, tz)` (UTC ms of wall-clock `iso` `hhmm` in `tz`) = `const u = Date.parse(iso + "T" + hhmm + ":00Z"); return u - zoneOffsetMs(u - zoneOffsetMs(u, tz), tz);`; `addDays` from `@/lib/period-pages`.
  - `CalendarLive({ online })`: `const prefs = useQuery(api.preferences.get, {}); const tz = prefs?.timeZone ?? "UTC"; const today = isoInZone(Date.now(), tz); const [month, setMonth] = useState<string | null>(null); const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);` — when `prefs` first arrives and `month === null`: `setMonth(today.slice(0, 7)); setSelected(today)`. `const first = (month ?? today.slice(0, 7)) + "-01"; const nextFirst = addDays(first, 32).slice(0, 7) + "-01";` Range `{ startMs: zonedMs(first, "00:00", tz), endMs: zonedMs(nextFirst, "00:00", tz) }` (one calendar month ≤ 31 days + 1 h, inside the 32-day cap). `const events = useQuery(api.calendar_events.listInRange, prefs && month ? range : "skip");` Mutations `create = useMutation(api.calendar_events.create)`, `remove = useMutation(api.calendar_events.remove)`; local state `const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState<CalendarData["toast"]>(null); const undoRef = useRef<(() => Promise<unknown>) | null>(null);` (`CalendarData` is exported by `CalendarView`).
  - Derived: grid `days` = from `gridStart = addDays(first, -((dow(first) - prefs.weekStartsOn + 7) % 7))` to `gridEnd = addDays(lastOfMonth, (prefs.weekStartsOn + 6 - dow(lastOfMonth)) % 7)` inclusive, where `dow(iso) = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay()` and `lastOfMonth = addDays(nextFirst, -1)`; each `{ date, n: Number(date.slice(8)), outside: date.slice(0, 7) !== month, today: date === today, dots }` with `dots` = one entry per event whose `isoInZone(startsAtMs, tz) === date`, in start order, each `"done"` when `(endsAtMs ?? startsAtMs) < Date.now()` else `"fixed"` (every stored event is a fixed-time item until R3-Q3 is answered). `dayEvents` = events with `isoInZone(startsAtMs, tz) === selected`, sorted by `startsAtMs`, mapped `{ id: e._id, title: e.title, startsAtMs: e.startsAtMs, endsAtMs: e.endsAtMs, kind: "fixed" }`. `state`: `prefs === undefined || month === null || events === undefined` → `"loading"`; `events.length === 0` → `"empty"`; else `"default"`.
  - Handlers: `onSelectDay(date)` → `setSelected(date)`; when `date.slice(0, 7) !== month`, also `setMonth(date.slice(0, 7))`. `onPrevMonth` → `m = addDays(first, -1).slice(0, 7)`; `onNextMonth` → `m = nextFirst.slice(0, 7)`; both then `setMonth(m); setSelected(today.slice(0, 7) === m ? today : m + "-01")`. `onOpenAdd` → `setSheetOpen(true)`; `onCloseAdd` → `setSheetOpen(false)`. `onAddEvent(v)` → `setSaving(true); try { const eventId = await create({ title: v.title, startsAtMs: zonedMs(v.date, v.start, tz), endsAtMs: zonedMs(v.date, v.end, tz) }); undoRef.current = () => remove({ eventId }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); setSheetOpen(false); setSelected(v.date); setMonth(v.date.slice(0, 7)); } finally { setSaving(false); }` (`v.kind` and `v.place` are not stored: no field exists — R3-Q3). `onUndo()` → `const u = undoRef.current; undoRef.current = null; setToast(null); if (u) await u();`. `onDismissToast()` → `undoRef.current = null; setToast(null)`. `onRetry` is supplied by the boundary.
  - Render: `<CalendarView state={state} data={{ month: month ?? today.slice(0, 7), weekStartsOn: prefs?.weekStartsOn ?? 1, days, today, selected: selected ?? today, dayEvents, timeZone: tz, sheet: { open: sheetOpen, saving }, toast }} online={online} …handlers />`.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  import type { ReactNode } from "react";
  export type HabitsState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type HabitsCadence = "daily" | "weekly";
  export type HabitsDay = { localDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */; weekday: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 /* 0 = Sunday */; day: number /* 1–31 */; isToday: boolean };
  export type HabitsItem = { id: string; name: string; cadence: HabitsCadence; loggedDates: string[] /* YYYY-MM-DD within days, today excluded */; loggedToday: boolean };
  export type HabitsToast = { habitId: string; undoUntilMs: number };
  export type HabitsData = {
    todayKey: string;          // YYYY-MM-DD, the person's local day
    days: HabitsDay[];         // exactly 7, oldest first, last one isToday
    habits: HabitsItem[];      // newest first; empty in "empty" | "loading" | "error"
    saveError: boolean;        // a check-in, create or undo failed
    toasts: HabitsToast[];     // one per habit added in the last 5 minutes
  };
  export type HabitsDraft = { name: string; cadence: HabitsCadence };
  export type HabitsViewProps = {
    state: HabitsState;
    data: HabitsData;
    online: boolean;
    suggestions?: ReactNode;   // rendered only in "default", after the quick-add form
    onToggleToday: (habitId: string) => void;
    onCreate: (draft: HabitsDraft) => Promise<void>; // rejects when the save failed
    onUndoCreate: (habitId: string) => Promise<void>;
    onCloseToast: (habitId: string) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function HabitsView(props: HabitsViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

click opens the sheet. 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />` (default text) directly under the header in every state. 3) `data.saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) State body: `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={4} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="habit" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} action={newButton} />` then the quick-add form; `default` → `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="hb-today">` with `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="hb-today"><span>{today}</span> · <span>{longDate(todayKey)}</span></h2><span className="tp-section__count"><span className="tp-num">{loggedCount}</span> <span>{of}</span> <span className="tp-num">{habits.length}</span> <span>{loggedTodayWord}</span></span></div>`, `<p className="tp-muted tp-small">{localDay with {day} = weekday-long name of todayKey}</p>`, `<div className="hb-list">` with one card per habit, then the quick-add form, then `{suggestions}`. 5) Card: `<article className="tp-surface tp-block-habit hb-card" data-component="HabitBlock">` → `<div className="tp-habit" data-habit={id} data-logged={String(loggedToday)}>` → head `<div className="tp-habit__head">` with `<a className="tp-habit__name" id={\`hb-${id}-name\`} href={\`/habits/${id}\`} dir="auto">{name}</a>`, `<span className="tp-habit__when">{cadence === "weekly" ? rhythmWeekly : rhythmDaily}</span>`, and `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary tp-habit__log" aria-pressed={loggedToday} aria-describedby={\`hb-${id}-name\`} aria-label={label + (loggedToday ? unlogSr : logSr).replace("{name}", name)}>` (`label` = `logged` or `log`) holding `<TpIcon name="check" size="sm" />` + `<span>{label}</span>`; click → `onToggleToday(id)`. Then `<ol className="tp-habit-days" aria-label={last7}>` with 7 `<li className="tp-habit-day" data-done={String(done)} data-today={isToday ? "true" : undefined}>` each holding `<span className="tp-habit-day__dot" aria-hidden="true"><TpIcon name="check" /></span>`, `<span className="tp-habit-day__label"><span>{dow[weekday]}</span> <span className="tp-num">{day}</span></span>`, `<span className="tp-sr-only">{done ? dayDone : dayOpen}</span>`, where `done` = `isToday ? loggedToday : loggedDates.includes(localDate)`. Then `<p className="tp-habit__summary">` rendering `summary` with `{n}` = count of done days and `{total}` = `7`, each number in `<span className="tp-num">`. 6) Quick-add form (in `default` and `empty`): `<form className="tp-toolbar" data-component="Toolbar" noValidate>` → `<div className="tp-field tp-toolbar__grow"><label className="tp-sr-only" htmlFor="habits-library-name">{quickLabel}</label><input className="tp-input" id="habits-library-name" type="text" dir="auto" autoComplete="off" maxLength={HABIT_NAME_MAX} placeholder={placeholder} aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} aria-describedby={invalid ? "hb-quick-error" : undefined} />{invalid ? <p className="tp-error-text" id="hb-quick-error">{quickError}</p> : null}</div>` and `<button className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" type="submit" disabled={busy}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{quickAdd}</span></button>`. 7) Sheet: when open, `<HabitSheet id="new-habit" title={newHabit} initial={{ name: "", cadence: "daily" }} onSubmit={onCreate} onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)} />`. 8) Toasts: when `data.toasts.length > 0`, `<div className="tp-toast-region">` with one `<UndoToast key={habitId} title={added} undoUntilMs={undoUntilMs} onUndo={() => onUndoCreate(habitId)} onClose={() => onCloseToast(habitId)} />` each. Tokens come only from tempo.css/habits.css classes: `.hb-list` gap `--tp-space-4`, `.hb-card` gap `--tp-space-3`, dot `calc(var(--tp-space-6) + var(--tp-space-1))` = 28 px with `--tp-line-control` ring and `--tp-done` fill.
  **Behaviour:** `longDate(key)` = `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" })`; `locale` = `"he-IL"` for `he`, else `"en-GB"`. Quick add submit: `preventDefault()`; if a submit is already running (a `useRef(false)` flag set before the first `await`) do nothing; trimmed name empty → `invalid = true`, focus the input, no callback; else `invalid = false`, `busy = true`, `await onCreate({ name, cadence: "daily" })`; on success clear the input; on rejection keep the text (the route shows `saveError`); finally `busy = false` and clear the flag. Typing clears `invalid` once the trimmed value is not empty. `loggedCount` = habits with `loggedToday`.
  **States** (harness order; route fixture names match): `default` (two habits), `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `offline` (`state: "default"`, `online: false`), `save-error` (`state: "default"`, `data.saveError: true`), `toast` (`state: "default"`, one toast). There is no disabled state; offline keeps every control enabled (changes queue in Convex). Welcome-back/Start fresh/Pause from the design are out of scope (no backend; the builder lists this under REPORT `notes for ticket sync`).

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type HabitDetailState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";
  export type HabitDetailCadence = "daily" | "weekly";
  export type HabitDetailCell = { localDate: string; day: number /* 1–31 */; checked: boolean; isFuture: boolean; isToday: boolean };
  export type HabitDetailWeek = { startDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD, a weekStartsOn day */; cells: HabitDetailCell[] /* exactly 7 */ };
  export type HabitDetailSummary = { logged: number; total: number; easiestWeekday: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | null; todayLogged: boolean };
  export type HabitDetailData = {
    habit: { id: string; name: string; cadence: HabitDetailCadence } | null; // null in loading | error | not-found
    todayKey: string;
    weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6;
    weeks: HabitDetailWeek[];      // exactly 6, oldest first; empty array when habit is null
    summary: HabitDetailSummary;
    saveError: boolean;
  };
  export type HabitDetailDraft = { name: string; cadence: HabitDetailCadence };
  export type HabitDetailViewProps = {
    state: HabitDetailState;
    data: HabitDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onToggleDay: (localDate: string) => void;
    onSaveEdit: (draft: HabitDetailDraft) => Promise<void>; // rejects when the save failed (HabitSheet shows its own error)
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function HabitDetailView(props: HabitDetailViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="HabitDetailView">`, first child always the back link `<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/habits">` (`next/link`) with `<TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" className="tp-icon--back" />` + `<span>{back}</span>`. `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={6} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `not-found` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="habit" size="lg" />} title={gone} />`. `default` / `empty`: 1) `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` with `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title" dir="auto">{habit.name}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{cadence === "weekly" ? subWeekly : subDaily}</p></div>` and `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions"><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" aria-controls="edit-habit" aria-expanded={editOpen}><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /><span>{edit}</span></button></div>`. 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />` (also shown in `loading`). 3) `saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) `empty` only → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="habit" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} />`. 5) `<div className="hd-stack"><section className="tp-surface tp-block-habit" data-component="HabitBlock" aria-labelledby="hd-grid-title"><div className="tp-habit hd-card" data-habit={habit.id} data-logged={String(summary.todayLogged)}>`: head `<div className="tp-habit__head">` = `<h2 className="tp-habit__name tp-h3" id="hd-grid-title">{grid}</h2>`, `<span className="tp-habit__when"><span>{todayIs}</span> <span>{shortDate(todayKey)}</span></span>`, `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary tp-habit__log" aria-pressed={summary.todayLogged} data-component="Button">` (`<TpIcon name="check" size="sm" />` + `<span>{todayLogged ? logged : log}</span>`; click → `onToggleDay(todayKey)`).  
  ```ts
  function buildWeeks(todayKey: string, weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6, logged: ReadonlySet<string>): HabitDetailWeek[] {
    const offset = ((parseLocalDate(todayKey)?.getDay() ?? 0) - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const gridStart = addLocalDays(addLocalDays(todayKey, -offset), -35);
    return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((w) => {
      const cells = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((d) => {
        const key = addLocalDays(gridStart, w * 7 + d);
        return { localDate: key, day: Number(key.slice(8)), checked: logged.has(key), isFuture: key > todayKey, isToday: key === todayKey };
      });
      return { startDate: cells[0].localDate, cells };
    });
  }
  ```

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type RoutineDetailState = "default" | "paused" | "finished" | "empty" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";
  export type RoutineStepStatus = "done" | "now" | "skipped" | "next";
  export type RoutineDetailStep = { title: string; note: string | null; minutes: number | null };
  export type RoutineDetailRun = { index: number /* current step; === steps.length when finished */; statuses: RoutineStepStatus[]; paused: boolean };
  export type RoutineDetailData = {
    routine: { id: string; title: string /* "" → Untitled */; steps: RoutineDetailStep[]; minutes: number | null } | null; // null in loading | error | not-found
    run: RoutineDetailRun;      // statuses.length === steps.length
    resumed: boolean;           // the route picked up a saved place on open
  };
  export type RoutineDetailViewProps = {
    state: RoutineDetailState;
    data: RoutineDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onDone: () => void;
    onSkip: () => void;
    onTogglePause: () => void;
    onBack: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function RoutineDetailView(props: RoutineDetailViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="RoutineDetailView">`, first child the back link `<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/routines">` (`<TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" className="tp-icon--back" />` + `<span>{back}</span>`). `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={3} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `not-found` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="list" size="lg" />} title={gone} />`. Other states: header `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title" dir="auto">{title || untitled}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{sub}</p></div></header>`, then `online === false` → `<StateOffline />`. `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="list" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} action={editLink("secondary")} />`. `default` / `paused` / `finished` → `<div className="tp-split" data-component="Split">` holding: (a) `finished`: `<section className="tp-status-panel" data-tone="done" data-component="StatusPanel" aria-labelledby="rd-finish-title">` = `<span className="tp-status-panel__icon"><TpIcon name="leaf" size="lg" /></span>`, `<h2 className="tp-status-panel__title" id="rd-finish-title" tabIndex={-1}>{finTitle}</h2>`, `<p className="tp-status-panel__body"><span>{finDone}</span> <span className="tp-num">{doneCount}</span> · <span>{finSkipped}</span> <span className="tp-num">{skippedCount}</span>. <span>{finBody}</span></p>`, `<div className="tp-status-panel__actions"><Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/today"><TpIcon name="today" size="sm" /><span>{finToday}</span></Link><Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/routines"><span>{back}</span></Link></div>`; otherwise `<section className="tp-surface rd-guide" data-component="Surface" aria-labelledby="rd-step-title" id="rd-guide">` = `<output className="tp-eyebrow block" aria-live="polite" id="rd-progress">` rendering `progress` with `{n}` = `index + 1`, `{total}` = steps count in `.tp-num`; `<ol className="rd-dots" aria-hidden="true">` with `<li><span className={\`tp-dot tp-dot--${DOT[status]}\`} /></li>` per status (`DOT = { done: "done", now: "fixed", skipped: "flex", next: "habit" }`); `<div className="rd-step"><h2 className="tp-page-title" id="rd-step-title" tabIndex={-1} dir="auto">{step.title}</h2>{step.note ? <p className="tp-muted" dir="auto">{step.note}</p> : null}{step.minutes ? <p className="tp-small tp-muted"><TpIcon name="clock" size="sm" /> <span>{about}</span> <span className="tp-num">{step.minutes}</span> <span>{min}</span></p> : null}</div>`; `paused` → `<Notice tone="info" title={pausedTitle} body={pausedBody} live="status" />`; `<output className="tp-muted tp-small block" aria-live="polite" data-testid="routine-said">{said ? copy[SAID[said]] : ""}</output>`; `<div className="rd-actions">` = Done `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={paused} data-component="Button">` (`check` icon + {done}) → `onDone()`; Skip `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" disabled={paused}>` (`arrow` icon `flip` + {skip}) → `onSkip()`; Pause `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" aria-pressed={paused}>` (`play` icon + {resume} when paused, else `pause` icon + {pause}) → `onTogglePause()`; Back (only when `index > 0`) `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" disabled={paused}>` (`undo` icon + {backStep}) → `onBack()`. (b) always: `<section className="tp-section rd-aside" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="rd-all">` = `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="rd-all">{all}</h2>{minutes !== null ? <span className="tp-section__count"><span>{about}</span> <span className="tp-num">{minutes}</span> <span>{min}</span></span> : null}</div>`, `<List label={all}>` with one `<ListRow title={step.title} icon={<TpIcon name={ICON[status]} size="sm" flip={status === "now" || status === "skipped"} />} end={copy[WORD[status]]} current={status === "now"} />` per step (`ICON = { done: "check", now: "play", skipped: "arrow", next: "clock" }`), then `editLink("ghost")` = `<Link className={\`tp-btn tp-btn--${variant}\`} href={\`/notes/${routine.id}\`}><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /><span>{edit}</span></Link>`. `step` = `steps[Math.min(index, steps.length - 1)]`; `doneCount`/`skippedCount` count `statuses`.
  **Behaviour:** local `said: "done" | "skipped" | "reopened" | "resumed" | null`, initial `data.resumed ? "resumed" : null`; Done → `said = "done"`, Skip → `"skipped"`, Back → `"reopened"`, Pause/Resume → `null`; `SAID = { done: "saidDone", skipped: "saidSkipped", reopened: "saidReopened", resumed: "saidResumed" }`. After Done, Skip or Back a `useRef` flag makes the next render's effect focus `#rd-step-title`, or `#rd-finish-title` when `state === "finished"`.
  **States** (harness order): `default` (step 2 of 3 running), `paused`, `finished`, `resumed` (`default` + `resumed: true`), `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `not-found`, `offline` (`default` + `online: false`). No disabled state beyond `paused` disabling Done/Skip/Back.

  ```ts
  export type GoalsState = "default" | "filtered-empty" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type GoalStatusWord = "active" | "resting" | "done";   // stored active | archived | completed
  export type GoalsFilter = "all" | GoalStatusWord;
  export type GoalCardData = { id: string; title: string; why: string | null; status: GoalStatusWord };
  export type GoalsToast = { goalId: string; undoUntilMs: number };
  export type GoalsData = {
    goals: GoalCardData[];     // already filtered, newest-updated first
    filter: GoalsFilter;
    creating: boolean;         // a create is in flight
    saveError: boolean;
    toast: GoalsToast | null;  // the goal added in the last 5 minutes
  };
  export type GoalsViewProps = {
    state: GoalsState;
    data: GoalsData;
    online: boolean;
    onFilterChange: (filter: GoalsFilter) => void;
    onCreate: (title: string) => Promise<string>; // resolves the new goal id; rejects when the save failed
    onUndoCreate: (goalId: string) => Promise<void>;
    onCloseToast: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function GoalsView(props: GoalsViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```

  **Behaviour:** local `naming`, `name`, `nameEmpty`, `focusTarget: string | null`. Opening the form (`#gl-new` or `#gl-first`) sets `naming = true` and focuses `#gl-name`. Submit: `preventDefault()`; trimmed name empty → `nameEmpty = true`, focus `#gl-name`, no callback; else `nameEmpty = false`, `const id = await onCreate(title)`, then `naming = false`, clear `name`, focus `#goal-<id>-link` on the next render (an effect retries until the element exists, then clears `focusTarget`); a rejection keeps the form open with its text. Typing a non-empty value clears `nameEmpty`. Cancel or Escape in the input: `naming = false`, focus `#gl-first` when `state === "empty"`, else `#gl-new`.
  **States** (harness order): `default`, `filtered-empty`, `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `offline` (`default` + `online: false`), `save-error` (`default` + `saveError: true`), `toast` (`default` + a toast), `creating` (`default` + `creating: true`: New goal disabled).

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const WHY_SAVE_DELAY_MS = 800;
  export type GoalDetailState = "default" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";
  export type GoalDetailStatus = "active" | "resting" | "done";   // stored active | archived | completed
  export type GoalDetailData = {
    goal: { id: string; title: string; why: string | null; status: GoalDetailStatus } | null; // null in loading | error | not-found
    saveError: boolean;
  };
  export type GoalDetailViewProps = {
    state: GoalDetailState;
    data: GoalDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onSaveTitle: (title: string) => void;            // trimmed, non-empty, different from data
    onSaveWhy: (why: string | null) => Promise<void>; // null clears it; rejects when the save failed
    onSetStatus: (status: GoalDetailStatus) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function GoalDetailView(props: GoalDetailViewProps): JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page gd-stack" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="GoalDetailView">`, first child the back link `<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm" href="/goals"><TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" className="tp-icon--back" /><span>{back}</span></Link>`. `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={2} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={onRetry} />`; `not-found` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="flag" size="lg" />} title={gone} action={<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/goals"><span>{back}</span></Link>} />`. `default`: 1) `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` = `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title"><input className="gx-title-input" aria-label={titleLabel} dir="auto" value={title} /></h1><div className="tp-pagehead__sub gd-meta"><Badge label={statusWord} tone={TONE[status]} icon={<TpIcon name={ICON[status]} size="sm" />} /></div></div>` (`TONE = { active: "info", resting: "neutral", done: "done" }`, `ICON = { active: "play", resting: "pause", done: "check" }`) and `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions gd-status"><Select id="gd-status" label={statusLabel} value={status} options={[{ value: "active", label: active }, { value: "resting", label: resting }, { value: "done", label: done }]} onChange={(v) => v !== status && onSetStatus(v as GoalDetailStatus)} /></div>`. 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />`. 3) `saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) `<div className="gd-stack">` = `<section className="tp-section gd-why" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="why-h"><div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="why-h">{whyHeading}</h2></div><div className="tp-surface" data-component="Surface"><textarea className="gd-why__input" aria-labelledby="why-h" dir="auto" spellCheck placeholder={whyDraft} value={why} /></div></section>` and `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="flag" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} />`. Tokens via goals.css (`.gd-stack` gap `--tp-space-6`) and the composed components.
  **Behaviour (title):** local `title`, initialised from `goal.title` and re-synced whenever `goal.title` changes while the input is not focused (a `useRef` focus flag). Enter blurs the input. On blur: `next = title.trim()`; empty → restore `goal.title`, no callback; `next !== goal.title` → `onSaveTitle(next)`. **Behaviour (why):** local `why` (initial `goal.why ?? ""`) and `savedWhy` ref (initial the same); both re-sync from `goal.why` while the textarea is not focused. Each change sets `why` and restarts a `window.setTimeout(WHY_SAVE_DELAY_MS)` that calls `saveWhy(value)`. `saveWhy(value)`: clear the timer; if `value === savedWhy.current` do nothing; else `onSaveWhy(value.trim() ? value : null).then(() => { savedWhy.current = value; })` (a rejection leaves `savedWhy` unchanged, so blur tries again). On blur: if `why !== savedWhy.current` call `saveWhy(why)`; else re-sync from `goal.why`. The timer is cleared on unmount. **Behaviour (status):** the Select change calls `onSetStatus` only when the value differs.
  **States** (harness order): `default`, `no-why` (`default` with `why: null`), `loading`, `error`, `not-found`, `offline` (`default` + `online: false`), `save-error` (`default` + `saveError: true`). Offline keeps every field editable.

- **Stage:** C · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** none · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); lane `convex-arch` per `factory/SLOTS.md`.

- **GOAL:** `memories` holds an optional 1,024-float embedding and a Convex vector index over it, filtered by `userId`, so recall-by-meaning can run.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/schema.ts` (one table edit + one index) · `convex/lib/testFakeCtx.ts` (add a fake embedding helper if absent) · test: `convex/schema.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/schema.ts` (additive column + vector index; no existing column changed).
- **STEPS:** 1) Graphify code-map check of `convex/schema.ts` → `memories` (the field/index may already exist — then verify and add the missing test). 2) Add `embedding: v.optional(v.array(v.float64()))` to `memories`. 3) Add `.vectorIndex("by_userId_embedding", { vectorField: "embedding", dimensions: 1024, filterFields: ["userId"] })`. 4) Add a Zod/validator guard elsewhere is out of scope; only the column + index land here. 5) Write a schema unit test asserting the index registers (dimensions 1024, filter `userId`) and that an insert with and without `embedding` validates. 6) Run DONE.

No other table changes. Error case: a vector of wrong length must be rejected by Convex at insert. Given crisis words / When `send` runs / Then the fixed card is stored and no model is called. Given two overlapping Retries / When both run / Then one claims the turn and the other resolves "busy".

- **STEPS:** 1) Graphify code-map (exists — verify). 2) Fill coverage for `duplicateOfOpenTask`, `normalizeTitle`, `cardTitle`, the `ALREADY_ON_TODAY_NOTE` EN/HE, and the `coach.runCoachReply` drop + note path. 3) Run DONE.

- **SPEC:** `normalizeTitle(title: string): string` — NFKC-normalises, lowercases, strips Hebrew marks, emoji marks and every non-letter/digit/mark char; `""` when no letters or digits. `cardTitle(title: string): string` — `truncate(title.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " "), COACH_LIMITS.titleChars)` (one line, at most `COACH_LIMITS.titleChars = 200`). `duplicateOfOpenTask<T extends { title: string }>(proposal: CoachProposal | null, openTasks: readonly T[]): T | null` — returns the first of the first `MAX_OPEN_TASKS_CHECKED = 200` open tasks whose `normalizeTitle(cardTitle(task.title))` equals `normalizeTitle(proposal.title)`; `null` otherwise. Detection only — it never drops or appends. The drop + note is `coach.runCoachReply` in `convex/coach.ts`: when the first answer's task card is a duplicate, the card is dropped (`proposal: null` after `withoutAcceptPromise`) and the reply ends with `ALREADY_ON_TODAY_NOTE[locale]`. `ALREADY_ON_TODAY_NOTE` (EN/HE) and `MAX_OPEN_TASKS_CHECKED=200` are exported; note copy kept as-is.
- **TESTS:** Given a proposal whose title matches an open Today task / Then `coach.runCoachReply` drops the card (no `toolCalls`, no new task) and appends `ALREADY_ON_TODAY_NOTE.en` (`.he` in a Hebrew locale). Given a genuinely new task / Then the card stays and no note is appended. Given `normalizeTitle("Call Mom")`, `"CALL MOM"` and `"  call\tmom "` / Then all equal `"callmom"`. Given exactly `MAX_OPEN_TASKS_CHECKED` (200) open tasks with the match last (index 199) / Then `duplicateOfOpenTask` finds it; a match at index 200 (the 201st) is not checked.

Constants: `GRANTED_ENTITLEMENT_TIER: EntitlementTier = "max"`, `GRANTED_USER_TYPE: UserType = "paid"`, `GRANTED_BETA_ACCESS: BetaAccess = "tester"`, `GRANTED_SUBSCRIPTION = { plan: "max", billingCycle: "lifetime", status: "active", trialUsed: true, source: "open_signup_grant" }`. Signatures: `newUserFields(profile: SignInProfile, now: number, approvalStatus: "pending" | "approved" = "pending")` → the new-user fields object; `buildReturningUserPatch(existing: ReturningUserSnapshot, profile: SignInProfile, now: number): ReturningUserPatch`; `shouldGrantSubscription(existing?: SubscriptionGrantSnapshot | null): boolean`. Types: `SignInProfile = { email: string; emailVerified?: boolean; fullName?: string }`, `ReturningUserSnapshot = { entitlementTier?: EntitlementTier; userType?: UserType; betaAccess?: BetaAccess }`, `SubscriptionGrantSnapshot = { plan: string; status: string; billingCycle?: string; source?: string }`. The invariant: `newUserFields` and `buildReturningUserPatch` must never include a key whose value is `undefined` (Convex `db.patch` would delete that field). `shouldGrantSubscription` returns true only for a missing row or the exact pre-open-signup placeholder `{ plan: "none", billingCycle: "none", status: "inactive", source: "beta_signup" }`.

Given an existing user missing `entitlementTier` · When `buildReturningUserPatch` · Then it heals to `"max"`. Given an explicit `"free"` userType · Then it is left alone. Given no subscription row · When `shouldGrantSubscription` · Then true. Given a live paid row (`{ plan: "pro", billingCycle: "monthly", status: "active", source: "revenuecat" }`) · When `shouldGrantSubscription` · Then false.

### TFV2-0335 — Study track: SM-2 algorithm (`convex/lib/sm2.ts`)
- **Stage:** E · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** none · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); area `backend`, lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** first (study track; after chunk D coach artifacts F-28 which produce flashcards).
- **WHY:** PRD F-90 (SM-2); TRD §5c; the SM-2 spec (https://super-memory.com/english/ol/sm2.htm).
- **GOAL:** `convex/lib/sm2.ts` exports a pure `scheduleSm2` function that maps (quality, previous state) to the next (intervalDays, repetitions, easeFactor).
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/sm2.ts` · test `convex/lib/sm2.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** none (pure module; no schema).
- **STEPS:** 1) Graphify code-map to confirm no `sm2.ts` exists; 2) implement `scheduleSm2(prev, quality)` with the canonical formulas; 3) clamp EF at 1.3; 4) write the unit test.
- **DONE:** `bun test convex/lib/sm2.test.ts` → all pass; `bun run typecheck` → exit 0.
- **EVIDENCE:** test output + typecheck exit code.
- **DO NOT:** do not persist anything; do not import Convex server types; do not touch `convex/schema.ts` (schema is TFV2-0336); do not weaken a check.
- **REPORT:** status / evidence / changed / unknowns / notes for ticket sync.
- **SPEC:** Signature: `scheduleSm2(prev: { repetitions: number; easeFactor: number; intervalDays: number }, quality: 0|1|2|3|4|5): { repetitions: number; easeFactor: number; intervalDays: number }`. Rules: quality < 3 resets repetitions to 0 and returns intervalDays 1 (relearn). Otherwise: repetitions n+1; interval = n===1 ? 1 : n===2 ? 6 : round(prev.intervalDays * prev.easeFactor); EF' = prev.easeFactor + (0.1 − (5−q)·(0.08 + (5−q)·0.02)), clamped to ≥1.3. Error cases: quality out of 0–5 → throw `RangeError`; non-finite easeFactor/interval → throw `RangeError`. Limits: EF ≥1.3 always; intervalDays integer ≥1.
- **TESTS:** Given quality 5, repetitions 0, EF 2.5 / When scheduled / Then repetitions 1, intervalDays 1. Given quality 5, repetitions 2, EF 2.5, interval 6 / When scheduled / Then intervalDays 15. Given quality 0 / When scheduled / Then repetitions 0, intervalDays 1. Given EF 1.3 and quality 0 / When scheduled / Then EF stays ≥1.3. Given quality 6 / When scheduled / Then throws RangeError.
- **NUMBERS:** SM-2 EF floor 1.3, I(1)=1 day, I(2)=6 days (https://super-memory.com/english/ol/sm2.htm).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (typesafe/jev-1.13): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

- **DO NOT:** do not add `allow-same-origin` or `allow-top-navigation`; do not pass a key, token or cookie into the frame; do not run untrusted code outside the frame; do not touch `convex/`, `.env`, workflows.

- **SPEC:** The frame gets only `allow-scripts`; it is sandboxed with an origin-null context and a restrictive CSP meta (`default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'`). The message protocol is `{ kind: "action", action, payload, requestId }` → parent replies `{ kind: "action-result", requestId, ok, result }`. Any action outside the manifest's `actions` list is answered `{ ok: false, error: "denied" }`. A code module that never received approval renders the fallback card instead of the frame. Visible copy EN/HE: `EN: "This plugin runs in an isolated box. It can't see your other data." / HE: "התוסף הזה רץ בארגז חול מבודד. הוא לא יכול לראות את שאר הנתונים שלך."`
- **TESTS:** Given an approved code module / When rendered / Then an iframe with `sandbox` containing `allow-scripts` and NOT `allow-same-origin` is present. Given an action outside the allowlist / When the frame posts it / Then the parent replies `denied`. Given an unapproved module / Then no iframe is mounted (fallback card). Given a disallowed `fetch` inside the frame / Then the CSP blocks it (asserted via the CSP meta string).
- **NUMBERS:** no same-origin / no key access = absolute invariant (TRD §7 rule 8) · message round-trip ≤ 50 ms (target; deterministic within a page).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (typesafe/jev-1.13): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

- **WHY:** TRD §7 rule 8 (never runs before the user approves it; never gets keys); PRD §5 RULES (accept/reject is law; confirmation before any external write); REWRITE-PLAN-v2 §6 chunk 6.
- **GOAL:** Every permission a plugin declares is granted or denied by the user at install time and stored per plugin, and no plugin action can exceed its grant.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/plugin-permissions.ts` · test `convex/lib/plugin-permissions.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** reads `plugins` (the stored grant); no new table (the grant rides on the `plugins.manifest`/`permissions` field).
- **STEPS:** 1) Graphify code-map (MISSING); 2) implement `grantPermissions({ pluginId, grants })` and `assertPermission({ pluginId, permission })`; 3) store granted permissions on the `plugins` row (a `grantedPermissions` field added to the manifest object, additive — do NOT touch `convex/schema.ts`); 4) make every plugin action path call `assertPermission` before executing; 5) write the test file for every error case below.
- **DONE:** `bun test convex/lib/plugin-permissions.test.ts` → all tests pass.
- **EVIDENCE:** paste the test output (pass count).

- **SPEC:** `grantPermissions({ pluginId, grants: PluginPermission[] })` upserts the granted set (subset of the manifest's declared permissions only). `assertPermission({ pluginId, permission })` throws `permission_denied` if the permission is not in the granted set, `plugin_not_found` if no row. External-write permissions (`write_today`, `schedule_job`, `web_request`) always re-ask at use time (confirmation before any external write, PRD F-131), never silently granted. No permission grants access to another user's data or to any secret.
- **TESTS:** Given a plugin declaring `read_pages` / When granted `read_pages` / Then `assertPermission` passes. Given a plugin granted nothing / When an action asserts `write_today` / Then `permission_denied`. Given a grant outside the declared set / Then rejected. Given a non-owner / When granting / Then `forbidden`. Given `web_request` / Then use-time confirmation is still required even when granted.
- **NUMBERS:** grant set is a subset of the manifest (exact invariant) · permission enum content → `UNKNOWN` (Amit, same as TFV2-0397).

- **GOAL:** A server-side module defines the spawn contract — request a one-shot `claude` process, run it to a bounded result, and return its output — without ever returning the user's OAuth token to a client.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/claude-spawn.ts` · test `convex/lib/claude-spawn.test.ts`.

- **SPEC:** `spawnClaude({ prompt, opts: { maxBytes, timeoutMs } }, runner)` returns `{ output: string; truncated: boolean; exitCode: number }`. The runner interface is `{ run(args: string[]): Promise<{ stdout: string; exitCode: number }> }`. Budgets: `maxBytes` default 32 KiB, `timeoutMs` default 60_000.
